title: v6.0.0 bulk-renamed DriveEditor across every package, and drive editors are now apps of type powerhouse/app
content:
v6.0.0 lists the rename under Breaking Changes with no migration table:

> **`DriveEditor` renamed** — a bulk rename was applied across all packages. Search your codebase for old `DriveEditor` references and update as directed by TypeScript.

The intended workflow is therefore compile-error-driven rather than documented symbol-by-symbol, which is worth knowing before going looking for a mapping that does not exist.

The terminology landed on **Drive-app**, and the concept is now a first-class generated module type rather than a special kind of editor. The CLI reference confirms the surface:

- `ph generate app` — "Generate a drive app", with `--name`, `--document-types`, `--dir`, `--all`, `--extract`, and a `--disable-drag-and-drop` flag.
- Its spec files are `powerhouse/app` documents: `--document` takes "Path to a `powerhouse/app` spec file (.phd or .json) to drive codegen", and `--extract` writes "a `powerhouse/app` spec for each existing drive app into `specs/apps/`".
- The CSS customization reference maps the `app-editor` slot to document type `powerhouse/app`.

So the rename is not only cosmetic: it aligns the drive-level UI with the same spec-document-as-source-of-truth model used for document models and editors, each with its own document type and its own `ph generate` subcommand.

The other subgraph-shaped breaking change in the same release reinforces the direction — generated subgraph code should be **deleted** (`rm -rf src/subgraphs/`) because subgraphs are now generated and loaded at runtime.

Provenance: academy `ReleaseNotes/v6.0.0.md:192` (Breaking Changes) for the rename; `04-Reference/07-CLITooling/00-PowerhouseCLI.md` App section and `03-Build/03-BuildingUserExperiences/04-CSSCustomization.md:135` for the `powerhouse/app` type and `ph generate app`. Academy 6.2.2-dev.45.
description: The release notes list the rename as a breaking change to fix by following TypeScript errors. The CLI now exposes ph generate app, whose spec files are powerhouse/app documents.
